verdict.rationale: Elastic documents its own query languages, ES|QL and PromQL, for querying metrics and running ad-hoc queries, and markets ES|QL speed for AI investigations. That is first-party query capability an external agent could use, but the pack never documents an external API endpoint or an agent integration. Trace querying through an API is also unevidenced, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the root paths. missing for 10: documented REST/query API reference for external callers, explicit external-agent or MCP access, programmatic trace and log query documentation, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL)
ES|QL delivers sub-second responses on millions of time series metrics — the speed AI investigations demand.
